nameForms.name: Medinan Muslim Community
nameForms.note: Muhammad led the community in Medina; it provided the political framework inherited by the first caliphs.
nameForms.noteCn: 穆罕默德在麦地那领导共同体；这一政治框架由最初几位哈里发继承。

nameForms.name: Rashidun Caliphate
nameForms.note: The first four caliphs led the expanding polity after Muhammad’s death.
nameForms.noteCn: 穆罕默德逝世后，前四任哈里发领导这一迅速扩展的政体。

holders.note: Muhammad established and led the Medinan Muslim community.
holders.noteCn: 穆罕默德建立并领导麦地那穆斯林共同体。

holders.note: Chosen after Muhammad’s death, Abū Bakr secured the community during the Ridda wars.
holders.noteCn: 穆罕默德逝世后，阿布·伯克尔获推举，并在里达战争中巩固共同体。

holders.note: ʿUmar succeeded Abū Bakr and oversaw the expansion into Syria, Iraq and Egypt.
holders.noteCn: 欧麦尔继承阿布·伯克尔，并见证政体扩展至叙利亚、伊拉克与埃及。

holders.note: ʿUthmān continued the conquests and commissioned the standard Qurʾanic recension.
holders.noteCn: 奥斯曼延续对外扩张，并主持形成《古兰经》的标准定本。

holders.note: ʿAlī led during the First Fitna; his death ended the Rashidun sequence.
holders.noteCn: 阿里在第一次内战中统治；其逝世标志正统哈里发序列的结束。
